Read the disk usage graph too
Flat at 99%: something capped (C, E, H, or A at steady retention)
Steady climb: A or B
Spikes with traffic: D

Where to run each check
Live host: impact, df / du gap, lsof (B and D only exist in running processes).
Snapshot clone: du, find, reading logs and config, so the busy host takes no extra I/O.
